WargaKosRecord.title: WargaKosRecord
WargaKosRecord.description: End-to-end encrypted boarding house resident record stored per authenticated owner.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the boarding house owner.

encryptedPayload.description: Base64 AES-256-GCM ciphertext of resident details JSON.

encryptionVersion.description: Schema version of client-side E2EE envelope.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SecurityVault.title: SecurityVault
SecurityVault.description: Per-user E2EE key derivation salt, verification ciphertext, and 2FA/biometric flags.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vault owner.

keyCheckCiphertext.description: Base64 AES-GCM ciphertext of constant verification marker.

biometricEnabled.description: Whether biometric fingerprint/face unlock is enabled.

totpSecretEncrypted.description: Optional AES-GCM encrypted Base32 TOTP secret.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last vault update.

/users/{userId}/warga_kos/{recordId}.description: Encrypted boarding house resident records belonging to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/security/{docId}.description: User E2EE vault metadata and 2FA settings (docId = vault).
